reason: I already reorder Toplux and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles, so I am not adding another one. $29.99 is more than what I pay now and I have no reason to switch.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I do not need a new brand when I already have one that works for me.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay now, around $20, or a sample sachet I could try for free before committing.
